neighbours.label: something unseen or not really there (no one else can see, seeing things that aren't there, matter we can't see, ever existed), as opposed to plain things one can see or buy
fire: She talks to a ghost who nobody else can see.
It is a strange kind of particle that we can't detect.
Patients may hear voices that aren't there.
He does not admit that the letter ever existed.
Her imaginary friend sits at the table.
The thief left no trace that he had ever been there.
The dark matter that no telescope can see holds it together.
There is an invisible wall that only she can sense.
quiet: She talks to a neighbor who lives next door.
It is a strange kind of paint that we can buy here.
Patients may hear music in the waiting room.
He does not know that the letter arrived.
Her best friend sits at the table.
The thief left his hat at the bank.
The small telescope that we bought is on the desk.
There is a tall wall that runs along the road.

notes: Other card tokens (' extra' in 'extra-long', 0.35) don't fit. 'everyone else can hear' reached 0.26 in a probe.
